dut_lichtuan.title: Public weekly schedule
dut_lichtuan.description:

{example}

data.weeks_ahead: Extra weeks to check (0 = current week only)
data.clear_history: Clear old history (check to clear once, auto-unchecks after clearing)

dut_coithi_account.title: Exam invigilation - Choose account
dut_coithi_account.description: A cb.dut.udn.vn account is already configured from another source. Reuse it to skip retyping the password, or add a different account.

dut_coithi_login.title: Exam invigilation - Log in
dut_coithi_login.description: Log in with your cb.dut.udn.vn account (once). Does NOT fetch salary data. After a successful login, the next step lets you pick semesters from a real list.

dut_deadline_diem_account.title: Grade deadlines - Choose account
dut_deadline_diem_account.description: A cb.dut.udn.vn account is already configured from another source. Reuse it to skip retyping the password, or add a different account.

dut_deadline_diem_login.title: Grade deadlines - Log in
dut_deadline_diem_login.description: Log in with your cb.dut.udn.vn account (once). Does NOT fetch student grades/names/IDs. After a successful login, the next step lets you pick semesters from a real list.

hocky.title: Choose semesters to track
hocky.description: You can select multiple semesters (e.g. current + next, or overlapping ones), so nothing is missed.

chon_khoa.title: Track another invigilator (optional)
chon_khoa.description: Pick a department to shorten the name list below, or skip if you don't need to track anyone besides yourself.

chon_giang_vien.title: Select lecturer(s) to track
chon_giang_vien.description: Multiple selection supported. Type to search if the list is long.
